notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello CrateTastrophers!

We are happy to release the first major patch for the game which includes:

[list]
[*] Challenge mode - fixed several bugs, added additional buttons to have a more seamless quit and return to start menu options
[*] Store - added graphical assets to clarify currency, fixed achievement related bugs and other inconsistencies
[*] General - bug fixes, repaired some assets
[/list]

With this patch the game runs better and smoother.

We are not done with this update! The next major patch will include new mechanics and brand new game options, so stay tuned.

Have fun everyone and we'll see you in the game!
